description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Quote request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Offers"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PurchaseOrder" name="Purchase order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsDelivery" name="Parts delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint email"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Project" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Quote request" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Purchase order" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrder" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstDelivery" name="First parts delivery" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterDelivery" name="Parts delivery" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Start_LaterDelivery" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapReorder" name="Purchase order" sourceRef="Task_SendCheapReorder" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastReorder" name="Purchase order" sourceRef="Task_SendFastReorder" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Contract project starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePartsList" name="Create list of required parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops" messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers from all shops" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Compare quantity, price, and delivery time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCheapest" name="Select the cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SupplyDecision" name="Can one shop supply enough parts?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListOneShop" name="Create order list for one shop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListSeveralShops" name="Create order lists for several shops"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderListMerge" name="Continue with order list"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialOrder" name="Send initial orders to shops" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive first parts batch" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildProject" name="Build contract project"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Contract" name="Building completed"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_LaterDeliveries" name="Handle later parts deliveries" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LaterDelivery" name="Another parts batch arrives" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_LaterDelivery" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordLaterBatch" name="Record received parts batch"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LaterDelivery" name="Batch recorded"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterDelivery_Record" sourceRef="Start_LaterDelivery" targetRef="Task_RecordLaterBatch"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaterDelivery_End" sourceRef="Task_RecordLaterBatch" targetRef="End_LaterDelivery"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder when stock falls below 5" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockBelow5" name="Stock falls below 5" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_StockBelow5">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockOfPart < 5</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCheapestReorder" name="Select the cheapest parts for reorder"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCheapReorder" name="Send cheapest reorder to shops" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CheapReorder" name="Cheapest reorder sent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapReorder_Select" sourceRef="Start_StockBelow5" targetRef="Task_SelectCheapestReorder"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapReorder_Send" sourceRef="Task_SelectCheapestReorder" targetRef="Task_SendCheapReorder"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapReorder_End" sourceRef="Task_SendCheapReorder" targetRef="End_CheapReorder"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder again when stock falls below 3" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockBelow3" name="Stock falls below 3" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_StockBelow3">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockOfPart < 3</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFastestReorder" name="Select the fastest parts for reorder"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFastReorder" name="Send fastest reorder to shops" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FastReorder" name="Fastest reorder sent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastReorder_Select" sourceRef="Start_StockBelow3" targetRef="Task_SelectFastestReorder"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastReorder_Send" sourceRef="Task_SelectFastestReorder" targetRef="Task_SendFastReorder"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastReorder_End" sourceRef="Task_SendFastReorder" targetRef="End_FastReorder"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_ComplainAtZero" name="Complain when stock reaches zero" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockZero" name="Stock reaches zero" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_StockZero">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockOfPart = 0</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends to complain about the web shops" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complaint" name="Complaint email sent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_Send" sourceRef="Start_StockZero" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_End" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="End_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CreateList" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateList_Query" sourceRef="Task_CreatePartsList" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Compare" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compare_Select" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCheapest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Decision" sourceRef="Task_SelectCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_SupplyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_OneShop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SupplyDecision" targetRef="Task_ListOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">oneShopCanSupplyRequiredQuantity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_SeveralShops" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SupplyDecision" targetRef="Task_ListSeveralShops">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not oneShopCanSupplyRequiredQuantity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShop_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ListOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrderListMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShops_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ListSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrderListMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_SendOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderListMerge" targetRef="Task_SendInitialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendOrder_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_Build" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="Task_BuildProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_End" sourceRef="Task_BuildProject" targetRef="End_Contract"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
